_comment: Project-level MCP server configuration. Loaded by Claude Code. See _engineer/ENGINEER-README.md for selection criteria.
_instructions: Add MCP servers here as you configure them.
Include a comment block for each server with: purpose, justification, and access scope.
Do not add servers that transmit sensitive data to third parties without consent.
Commit this file — it is not a secret store. Secrets go in .env or Key Vault.

There is no '_disabled' field. Any server listed under mcpServers is real and Claude Code will launch it once approved. To turn one off, remove it here or add its name to 'disabledMcpjsonServers' in .claude/settings.local.json.
Do not commit placeholder/example servers: they get approved into 'enabledMcpjsonServers' and then crash-loop on startup. Document examples in ENGINEER-README.md instead.
